questions.prompt: Which continent is Democratic Republic of the Congo in?

hints.nudge: A continent is one of the great land masses of the world. Find Democratic Republic of the Congo on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.
hints.whereToLook: Find Democratic Republic of the Congo on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.

questions.proof: Democratic Republic of the Congo is in Africa.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries covers the most ground?

hints.nudge: Area is how much ground a country covers, not how many people live there. A small crowded country can still be small.
hints.whereToLook: Compare the four on the Atlas. Area means how much ground a country covers.

questions.proof: By area: Democratic Republic of the Congo about 2,345,410 square kilometres; Mozambique about 801,590 square kilometres; Rwanda about 26,338 square kilometres; Mauritius about 2,040 square kilometres.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Democratic Republic of the Congo?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture Democratic Republic of the Congo on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Democratic Republic of the Congo article.

questions.proof: The Democratic Republic of the Congo borders the Central African Republic and South Sudan to the north; Uganda, Rwanda, and Burundi in the east; Zambia and Angola to the south; the Republic of the Congo, the Angolan exclave of Cabinda, and the Atlantic Ocean to the west.

questions.prompt: Which country has the capital city Kinshasa?

hints.nudge: Every country has one capital city. Find the city in the question on a map, then see which country it sits in.
hints.whereToLook: Look on the Atlas: find the city, then see which country it sits in.

questions.proof: The capital city of Democratic Republic of the Congo is Kinshasa.

questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Democratic Republic of the Congo?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Geography” part of the Democratic Republic of the Congo article.

questions.proof: The capital of the Democratic Republic of Congo is Kinshasa.
